item.title: Flipper Zero Firmware Development Shifts Toward Community Contributions
item.content:encoded:
Flipper Zero firmware development continues with community help — May Read

Flipper Devices says Flipper Zero firmware will continue to be maintained, but full-time feature development is ending as the company shifts resources to new devices. Future improvements will rely more heavily on community requests, votes, pull requests, and testing through GitHub Discussions.

  • Flipper Devices says development of the Flipper Zero firmware will continue with a smaller internal team and greater reliance on community contributions.
  • The company said the official Flipper Zero firmware will still be maintained, but full-time feature development is now over.
  • Flipper Zero Firmware 1.0 was announced in September 2024 after three years of development, and the latest official stable release is version 1.4.3 from December 2025.
  • The new project process will route requests through GitHub Discussions, where users can vote on priorities and community pull requests will face stricter review requirements.
  • Flipper Devices said more than one million Flipper Zero users generate more communication than its small team can manage, leading it to disable direct messages on all social media channels.
